topic.description: a subject in the knowledge graph that no project, package, component or design already is. Its doc is the cover: the title, and a line or two saying what belongs under it. Its content.body is the contents: what is understood about it, written as one document citing its sources. Its edges say what it holds (contains, a subtopic or any other entity), what to understand first (requires), what it reads or references, and what it cites; beliefs are about it (belief.about)

name.description: the title in lowercase, its spaces single; the topic's id is derived from it, so one name is one topic and naming it again finds the same one

scope.description: the project it holds for; absent for a topic that holds everywhere, as world or fleet knowledge

topic_new.title: Make a topic
topic_new.description: Make a topic, where no existing topic, project, package, component or design fits. name is what it is called, as plain and general as the subject is ("testing", "ui components", "naming"), never a phrase about one point; body is its cover, a line or two saying what belongs under it, never a point anybody made. scope names the project it holds for; leave it out for a topic that holds everywhere. One name is one topic: a name that is taken is refused with the topic that has it, to use instead, and so is a name whose words hold another topic's or are held by them ("economic market design" beside "market design"). Returns the applied bundles (JSON objects with entity ids and components); the topic's id is its entity.eid.

name.description: what the topic is called, a few plain words

body.description: a line or two saying what belongs under it

scope.description: project id or name it holds for; omit for a topic that holds everywhere

topic_find.title: Find topics
topic_find.description: Find existing topics: those whose name, title or cover holds each word in said, as the start of a word or by its stem ("data modeling" finds "data model", "tests" finds "testing"), ranked by meaning to the entity near names when the server has a vector index, or, given neither, the topics in order of name. Use it before making a topic, with near set to what you are filing under one, so a subject already named is reused rather than named again in other words. Returns bundles (JSON objects with entity ids and components), each whole; limit defaults to 12.

said.description: words the topic's name, title or cover holds, as the start of a word or by its stem

near.description: an entity id or name whose meaning ranks the topics
